{{Quote|You're with the best strike team in the galaxy. For us, nothing is impossible.|Tol Braga|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] assembled a '''strike team''' of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with the purpose of capturing and redeeming the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. Besides Master Braga, the team consisted of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Leeha Narezz]], [[Warren Sedoru]], [[Kira Carsen]], and the Knight known only as the [[Hero of Tython]]. The team was also assisted by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]], [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble]], also known as Doc, and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]].
